risks: The package signature status is notPresent and the Hub bundle is only ad-hoc signed.
Raw evidence artifacts under build/ are local and disposable; committed SHA-256 digests preserve identity but not availability.
Installation validatedAt/installedAt use the deterministic test clock and must not be interpreted as wall-clock capture timestamps.
The human validator contract currently requires four release checkpoints; broader visual, audio, controller and accessibility observations still need an explicit QA checklist.
A later code or content change creates a new candidate and invalidates this receipt until all candidate-bound evidence is regenerated.
